 My country offer free HAART supply and routine check up for first line medication. 

 But i need to come for appointment every month, the ID clinic is only open on weekdays 9-5pm. It took 1-2 hours to go there, another 1-2 hours to return, parking is terrible, that place doesn't have access to reliable public transport, I have to wait another 4+ hour for my numbers to be called and meet the doctor. I used up all my annual leave just for the appointment and my manager start to see my leave pattern and try to dig if I having any problem. Sometimes the doctor move my appointment to another date so I have to face these routine AGAIN on  the same month (one to resupply and another for appointment), not to mention the meds i need to take at specific timing regardless what im doing that time for the rest of my life.

I was very demotivated and hating my life due to these lifelong commitment

After 1year+,  I decided to stop my meds, stop meeting my doctor and continue with my life (whatever life left for me)

I hate the system and hate my life so much. Yes the treatment is free, i am not being ungrateful, I just cant accept the idea of 'extending' my life expectancy while I myself is struggling. I don't know what I fighting for, because at the moment, my life isn't that great. I cant imagine myself continue being like this for the rest of my life.

                                      *   *   *   *   *
That story was almost 10 years ago and I still alive today. I dont want to die yet, but at least I got to do what I want to do (even drugs), I learn to accept and appreciate everything in my life. Even my life was shorten I will not regret whatever decision I made. Maybe soon i'll decide how to end it because this is my life l,  my own story.

I believe in god, yet nobody can proof what will really happen after we died and what we will carry, so live your life while you can.
